'''Death Star II Light Side Starter Deck''' is a 60-card preconstructed [[Light]] deck published by [[Decipher]] on 19 July 2000 with [[Death Star II (expansion)|Death Star II]]. MSRP was $10.95. The exclusive rare [[Admiral Ackbar]] is packed only in this deck, not in Death Star II boosters. The Dark product is [[Death Star II Dark Side Starter Deck]]. The 60 mixes Death Star II cards and reprints from earlier sets with a 2000 copyright. A display box held 12 decks, 6 per side.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
